title: Air Fryer Gobi 65 (With Besan & Olive Oil)
originalTitle: Air fryer gobi 65 \- add besan & olivd oil
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into bite-sized florets
3 tbsp besan (gram/chickpea flour) — personal note upgrade for crunch
1 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp ground cumin
10 fresh curry leaves & 1 slit green chili
instructions: Blanch cauliflower florets in salted hot water for 3 minutes, then drain thoroughly and pat dry.

In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, besan (chickpea flour), rice flour, cornstarch, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chili powder, garam masala, turmeric, cumin, lemon juice, olive oil, and salt into a thick batter.
Toss the cauliflower florets and torn curry leaves in the spiced batter until evenly coated.
Preheat Air Fryer to 380°F (193°C). Arrange florets in a single layer, brush or mist with olive oil, and air-fry for 14–16 minutes, shaking halfway, until fiery, crisp, and charred at the edges.
